description: Scientific logbook / mission notebook transfer from source to target workspace.

steps.name: START
steps.description: Experiment initialized. Ready to begin notebook transfer sequence.
steps.next_suggestion: Place logbook / notebook flat in workspace source area.

steps.name: DETECT_NOTEBOOK
steps.description: Baseline verification: Notebook detected in source workspace zone.
steps.next_suggestion: Reach towards and grasp notebook with hand.

steps.name: PICK_NOTEBOOK
steps.description: Operator grasps notebook with hand interaction.
steps.next_suggestion: Transfer notebook horizontally across towards target zone.

steps.name: MOVE_TO_TARGET_ZONE
steps.description: Operator shifts notebook across workspace toward target zone.
steps.next_suggestion: Place notebook down in target workstation zone.

steps.name: PLACE_NOTEBOOK
steps.description: Operator places notebook down flat in target zone.
steps.next_suggestion: Withdraw hands from notebook to verify placement.

steps.name: VERIFY_PLACED
steps.description: Verification: Notebook stationary in target zone, hands retracted clear.
steps.next_suggestion: Transfer verified. Session telemetry being written.
